A. Purpose: To provide guideline instruction for facilitating referral of patient.

B. Scope: Hospital wide

C. Policy:

  • Decision to refer a patient for consultation to other clinical specialty will be taken by the primary treating consultant of the patient.
  • The primary treating consultant of the patient will indicate the same in writing in the patient’s medical records.
  • A referral slip containing details of the patient’s diagnosis, treatment given, reason for referral etc is filled by the referring consultant and the same is attached in the patient’s medical records.
  • In case the required medical specialty is not available in the hospital the treating consultant will refer the patient to the concerned specialty in the nearest tertiary care hospital/ Medical College Hospital.
  • The consultant referring the patient to the identified external healthcare institution will fill a referral slip indicating the diagnosis, treatment given, condition of the patient, investigations/procedures if any undertaken by the patient etc.
